shots.full: Keep the first reference photograph exactly as it is: the same night street, the same lit sign, the same red neon, the same camera position, framing, lens and focus. Add Barry in the lower left corner, very close to the camera, seen from the shoulders up and turned away from us, so we see the back and side of his head and one ear as he looks up at the sign. He is out of focus, softer than the sign, because the lens is focused far away on the sign. Light on him: the sign is above and beyond him, so only a thin white rim of light runs along the top of his head and the edge of his shoulder, the red neon puts a faint red tint on his cheek, and the rest of him is a dark shape against the night. Barry is dressed exactly as in his portrait reference. An unretouched photograph with the same grain and colour as the reference. 16:9. Thanks.

Keep the reference photograph exactly as it is: the same diner counter, the same waitress on the right, the same yellow jug, coffee pot, plates, wall of photos, camera position, framing, lens, focus and light. Add Denise standing behind the counter on the left, behind the yellow jug and the milk carton, at the same distance from the camera as the waitress, so her head is the same size as the waitress's head and level with it. She is side-on, both hands resting on the counter, looking across at the waitress with a flat, unimpressed face. The yellow jug and the milk carton stay in front of her and hide part of her body. Light on her: the same warm overhead light that falls on the waitress. An unretouched photograph with the same soft focus, grain and colour as the reference. 16:9. Thanks.
